answer: Bind each earning seat to a Legal Entity Identifier. The key must appear in the GLEIF record's signed website field, and LEIs whose Level 2 parent data or registered address collide merge into one seat, so the public atlas of ownership works like a prism splitting a farm back into its single owner. Each LEI costs ~$65/yr plus a real company filing, so 100 sybils pay ~$6,500/yr and leave 100 audit trails. Lapsed LEIs freeze payouts, and random spot checks with the business registry catch any attempt to forge a filing.
